scope: Actual compiled Svelte in Chromium; explicitly mocked native IPC and provider data only.

tests.name: Entering an existing origin preserves its path, query and fragment
Address parser distinguishes local hosts, search, unsafe schemes and credentials
Escape cancels address edits without navigation and restores tab focus
Find focuses immediately, supports reverse search and closes independently
Confirmation defaults to Cancel and traps browser shortcuts without destructive side effects
Command palette autofocus and keyboard selection remain visible while scrolling
Internal management navigation has predictable Back and Forward history
Page zoom readout follows each website instead of resetting on every switch
Copy feedback stays in the reserved footer, does not shift the website and expires
Disconnected state retains last-known profiles, labels staleness and blocks mutations
Loading an unavailable snapshot is not mislabeled as an empty workspace
Repeated identical actions in flight dispatch only one backend request
Errors survive unrelated successful actions and preserve path/message casing
Provider override drafts survive navigation and Reset does not mutate saved data
Provider edits are explicit; unchanged values cannot be resubmitted
Disabling a provider during work requires confirmation; Cancel restores the checkbox
Client setup includes working Start, health Check and confirmed Stop controls
A negative health result cannot produce a successful connection message
Unavailable explicit client model selection is not silently replaced by another model
Technical connection fields start collapsed; leaving the page hides revealed secrets
Ready filters and default-model actions respect model and provider exposure
Model filters persist, empty searches recover in place, and sorting toggles direction
Opening a session asks the backend for that conversation, not the provider homepage
Ending a session requires review and does not delete a website conversation
A failed session rename restores its saved value without a stale event error
Unsent tool task and server drafts survive navigation; invalid JSON is explained inline
Tool approvals remain visible while browsing and never auto-execute
A new or changed tool call resets the broader grant checkbox to Allow once
Removing a tool server requires confirmation without deleting its executable
Failed tool-server connection keeps the reviewed definition available for retry
Settings deep links open the right section, remember it and settle applied forms
Connector reset, diagnostic clearing and application close guard destructive effects
Filtered-empty Sessions and Activity recover without sending users into setup
All nine surfaces and five Settings sections stay bounded at three viewport sizes
Long provider labels, model names and identifiers cannot expand the whole window
Slow tab opening cannot override a newer tab or page selection
An in-flight confirmation cannot be half-dismissed; failures remain recoverable in its dialog
Reduced motion keeps readable working states without animation
